column2: Cat. A furry animal that says meow. A cat has four legs and sees well in the dark. It catches mice.
Dog. A friendly animal that barks. The dog is people's loyal friend. It has a strong sense of smell.
Bird. A small animal that flies and sings. A bird flies with wings and sings beautiful songs.
Cow. A farm animal that gives milk. A cow gives milk and eats grass in the meadow.
Rain. Water falling from the sky. Rain waters plants. Wear rain clothes when it is cloudy.
Sun. Bright light in the sky. The sun gives us light and warmth. Do not look directly at the sun.
Tree. A tall plant with leaves. Trees make oxygen for breathing. They give shelter to animals.
Water. Liquid we need to live. Your body needs water to stay hydrated and focused. Drink water regularly, especially when studying or doing sports.
Fire. Flames that give heat and light. Never play with fire. In a fire, get out right away and call emergency 112.
Wind. Moving air we feel on our skin. Wind is moving air. It can be a gentle breeze or a strong storm.
Car. A vehicle that goes vroom. A car moves with an engine. Always cross the street at a crosswalk.
Bicycle. A two-wheeled vehicle you pedal. Cycling is healthy and eco-friendly. Always wear a helmet and follow traffic rules.
Book. Pages with text and pictures to read. Reading builds knowledge and imagination. Books and audiobooks are for everyone.
Phone. Device for calls and messages. Use the phone to stay in touch and in emergencies. Call 112 for emergency, or your local police and fire numbers.
Clock. A device that shows the time. A clock tells us what time it is, so we can be on time.
Star. A bright point of light in the night sky. Stars are huge balls of light far away in space. The Sun is a star too.
Moon. A bright object that shines at night. The Moon orbits the Earth, and we see it as a bright ball at night.
Rocket. A vehicle that flies into space. A rocket flies very fast to carry people and equipment into space.
Planet. A big ball that orbits a star. Earth is a planet we live on. There are many other planets in space.
Drum. A musical instrument you hit. A drum is hit with hands or sticks to make a rhythm.
Guitar. A musical instrument with strings. A guitar has strings that vibrate when plucked, making beautiful music.
Bell. A small object that rings. A bell makes a clear sound when it's shaken or struck.

Educational picture books are available for different topics across several categories. Choose a category and go through all the picture books, where you'll hear something informative about the topic, with the option to also hear what sound it makes. Once you've gone through all the picture books, a quiz follows to test what you've learned. Good luck!
